General-metadata.description: Characteristics of a project, model, or dataset.  Whenever possible, values should link to other ontologies or controlled vocabularies.

Comments.description: Textual comments about the model, dataset, or project.

Contact.description: Physical address or email address of a contact.

License.description: License or rights to access this resource

Imaging.description: Imaging modalities, procedures, and other information

items.description: List of imaging modalities; requires value(s) from RadLex:RID10311

Procedures.description: Imaging procedures: each item should include procedure name, RadLex Playbook ID, and/or LOINC code

examples: CT Abdomen and Pelvis W contrast IV

Comments.description: Use this field to specify a file format of type 'Other'.

Indexing.description: Indexing codes: Content codes, RadLex, SNOMED, and keywords

Keywords.description: Array of keywords to index the resource

Model.description: An AI model, described by general metadata and model properties.

Indexing.description: Indexing information, such as content codes, RadLex + SNOMED codes, and keywords.

Model performance.description: An array of tuples that specify the performance of an AI model on a particular set of data.

Model-performance.description: An array of tuples that specify the performance of an AI model on a particular set of data.

Evaluation dataset.description: Data on which the model has been evaluated. One of more results (index text, value, confidence interval) for each dataset

Description.description: Textual description of the evaluation dataset

Model-performance-results.description: Array of tuples: (index test, metric, value)

items.description: Tuple of index test, metric, value

Index test.description: Describes what is being measured. For example, not simply large vessel occlusion (LVO), but M2/M3 LVO.

Level.description: Confidence level, expressed as a decimal value

Architecture.description: Textual description of underlying model technology, e.g., "Convolutional Neural Network".

Availability.description: Defines where and/or how the model is available; can include a URL.

Clinical benefit.description: Clinical benefits, such as diagnosis, risk assessment, or treatment selection.

Clinical workflow phase.description: Clinical workflow phase (e.g., patient pre-registration, digitization of forms or clinical  scales, patients’ triage, telehealth & virtual rounds, clinical decision support systems, workflow optimization, evidence-based methods to optimize medical interventions, feedback from users).

Degree of automation.description: Degree of automation compared to the current standard of care, including whether the device supports or automates decision making.

Indications for use.description: The indications for use describe: (1) the disease or condition that the AI system will diagnose, treat, prevent, cure, or mitigate; (2) the intended patient population; and (3) the intended use environment (e.g., ICU, step-down unit, home).

Input.description: Describes the type(s) of information used as input into the model; for example, abdomen/pelvis CT images and laboratory data.

Coded data.description: An array of coded data elements using RadLex, RadElement, SNOMED CT, LOINC, etc.

Instructions.description: Directions and recommendations for optimal use of the model.

Limitations.description: Describes concerns specific to the use of the AI model. Includes: (1) Known biases or failure modes; (2) Known gaps in the data characterization, such as patient populations that are not well represented in development (e.g., training) or testing datasets, and therefore, may be at risk of bias; (3) Limitations in the model development or performance evaluation; and (4) Known circumstances where the device input will not align with the data used in development and validation.

Output.description: Describes the type of output produced by the model, such as classification (diagnosis) results or image segmentation.

Coded data.description: An array of coded data elements using RadLex, RadElement, SNOMED CT, LOINC, etc.

Regulatory information.description: Information used to support or document regulatory review, covering one or more jurisdiction-specific authorization pathways (e.g. FDA, CE marking under EU MDR, UKCA).

Authorizations.description: One record per jurisdiction/pathway. Absence of a record does not imply absence of authorization; use Status "Not submitted" to state this explicitly. A model may hold more than one record, e.g. an original 510(k) plus supplements, or authorizations in multiple jurisdictions.

Jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction or regulatory region. Generally ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, except EU (economic area) and UK-NI (Northern Ireland, which follows EU MDR under the Windsor Framework rather than UKCA).

Authority.description: Regulatory authority or conformity-assessment body responsible for the authorization.

Authority identifier.description: Notified Body or Approved Body number, where applicable.

Status.description: Status of this authorization. "Not submitted" and "Research use only" are positive assertions and should be used in preference to omitting the record. "Not available" mirrors the ONC convention at 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11)(v)(A)(2).

Identifier.description: Submission or certificate number. FDA identifiers follow a fixed format (see examples); CE and UKCA certificate numbers are assigned in Notified/Approved Body house formats and vary.

Risk class.description: Jurisdiction-specific risk classification; not comparable across jurisdictions and should be interpreted only together with Jurisdiction.

Predicate device.description: 510(k) only. Predicate device identifier or name.

UDI-DI.description: Unique Device Identifier - Device Identifier, the model/version-level identifier assigned under a UDI system such as EUDAMED or the FDA GUDID.

Basic UDI-DI.description: Basic Unique Device Identifier - Device Identifier, the primary identifier of a device model grouping, used in EUDAMED and other UDI systems independent of packaging/version-level UDI-DIs.

Registry URL.description: Deep link to the public registry entry, where one exists.

EU AI Act.description: Co-classification under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. Independent of CE marking under MDR: a device may hold both.

Technical documentation.description: Status of the Annex IV technical documentation.

Change control.description: Predetermined change control, e.g. an FDA or MHRA Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP), or the technical solutions for continuous compliance described at EU AI Act Annex IV point 2(f). A plan may cover more than one jurisdiction.

PCCP in place.description: Indicates whether a predetermined change control plan is in place for this model.

Description.description: Description of the predetermined change control plan, such as the anticipated changes and the methods used to develop and validate them.

Jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions in which this change control plan has been reviewed or accepted.

Reproducibility.description: Describes the AI model's reproducibility associated with the provided outputs.

Sustainability.description: Describes parameters associated with use of the AI model related to energy consumption, running time, and other factors.

Other.description: Use(s) other than the enumerated values, specified as text.

Other user.description: User(s) other than the enumerated values, specified as text. Should specify intended, etc.

Contact name.description: Name or role of organizational contact

examples: 820 Jorie Blvd, Oak Brook, IL 60523-2251, USA

ORCID.description: Unique ORCID (Open Researcher and Contributor ID) identifier

Reference.description: A reference about the resource, such as a clinical trial identifier or a pointer to a peer-reviewed publication or conference proceedings

examples: The RSNA Abdominal Traumatic Injury CT (RATIC) Dataset

Source.description: Name of journal, book, or other source; or full citation (see example)

Clinical trial.description: A clinical trial identifier or URI, such as issued by ClinicalTrials.gov

Nonscalar-metric.description: Enumerated list of graphical and matrix metrics.

Scalar-metric.description: Enumerated list of scalar metrics. The list includes sensitivity, specificity, precision, and recall as frequently-used terms; they all are alternate terms (e.g., for true positive rate).

AUC of each class vs. the rest combined

fraction of cases with user adjustment
